name: Can a coffered ceiling be installed in any room, or are there limitations?

mainEntity.name: Can a coffered ceiling be installed in any room, or are there limitations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coffered ceilings can be installed in most rooms, but ceiling height is a crucial consideration. Since the beams create depth, they will slightly lower the effective ceiling height. We recommend a minimum ceiling height of eight feet to maintain a sense of openness. Rooms with very low ceilings might feel too enclosed. We assess your specific room dimensions during a consultation to ensure suitability and discuss the best approach.
